tools.name: scam_check
tools.description: Score a text, email, chat or voicemail transcript against Aya's scam rules (urgency, hard-to-reverse payments, credential and code requests, government or tech-support impersonation, prizes, family emergencies, deposits to unlock earnings, disguised links) in English or Spanish. Returns the risk lev

tools.name: link_check
tools.description: Extract up to 8 links from a text and judge each by its shape alone: brand lookalikes, raw IP hosts, shorteners, encoded international domains, risky suffixes, many subdomains or hyphens, credential-style paths. Nothing is fetched or resolved.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: scam_check · Private data: scam_check, link_check · Public sink: scam_check.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: scam_check · Private data: scam_check, link_check · Public sink: scam_check

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
